description:
Galetocherdo, a fearsome serpent shark with an unexpected soft spot, falls head over fins at first sight for a rabbit statue and decides then and there that a bunny will one day become his mate. So when he stumbles upon a white “rabbit” fast asleep on the roadside, he doesn’t hesitate to bring it home. There’s just one problem. Virdo insists he’s not a rabbit at all, but a hermaphroditic sea slug, and he very much did not agree to becoming anyone’s bride. Trapped in an unfamiliar place and relentlessly courted by a forceful yet strangely sweet shark who refuses to take no for an answer, Virdo is pushed into a whirlwind of misunderstandings, identity chaos, and dangerously close proximity. As Galetocherdo demands “proof” and the line between obsession and affection blurs, Virdo must find a way to escape...or survive...this wildly inappropriate marine matchmaking. 

A high-energy monster rom-com featuring one stubborn shark, one very unlucky sea slug, and a sea full of misunderstandings, My Bunny Bride delivers four times the chaos and four times the trouble.

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes six extra chapters.*
